summary: Wenatchee NF summit near Cle Elum. Register dates a 1930 tower and says it is gone; Willhite found no evidence of one on the summit.

facts.status_note: The register lists the tower as gone. A visitor who checked the ridgeline reports no evidence of one.

access.note: Summit is on Wenatchee National Forest land that hikers visit on foot, per Willhite.

events.note: Register and firelookout.com give 1930. Willhite cites the Kresek inventory for a tower of some kind that year but reports no evidence on the summit. Sources disagree.
Entered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register on August 11, 2012, after a nomination by Ray Kresek

evidence.quote: Built in 1930, this tower is now gone.

evidence.supports: about 11 miles southwest of Cle Elum
U.S. Forest Service administers the land
Kresek inventory records a tower of some kind in 1930
evidence.quote: The Kresek Lookout Inventory says there was a tower of some kind in 1930.

evidence.supports: visitors to the summit saw no evidence
evidence.quote: Numerous people who have visited the summit have told me they saw no evidence of any kind.
During my visit, I checked the entire ridgeline, including the southeast ridge past the summit.

evidence.supports: use brief, possibly a tent camp
evidence.quote: If this site was used, it was likely a short period and just a tent camp.

evidence.supports: hikers seldom visit this national forest corner
evidence.quote: Hikers seldom visit this southern corner of Wenatchee National Forest

evidence.supports: faint abandoned trail leads nearly to the summit
evidence.quote: A faint abandoned trail leads nearly to the summit.

evidence.supports: benchmark TANO 1958 on the rocky summit
evidence.quote: On the rocky summit is a benchmark called TANO 1958.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on whether a structure stood here. The register and firelookout.com say a 1930 tower stood and is gone. Willhite, citing the Kresek Lookout Inventory, reports a tower of some kind in 1930 but found no evidence on the summit. The story presents both without choosing. Do not confuse with the Wenatchee NF Lookout Mountain near Cle Elum (US 1413, 3,465 ft, 8 miles east), which shares the name and county; the Willhite page cited for that site is the 3,465-ft summit. Access 'public' rests on national forest land and Willhite's hiking account; the story gives no route. Willhite's own suggestion that this was a patrol point for North Ridge Lookout was left out as speculation. No photos added: Willhite's photos are credited as courtesy with no licence stated. Record check: elevation 6,198 ft and coordinates match the register; no corrections proposed.
